signature.name: Sunset ink (the showcase film)
signature.use: Deep violet ink with a warm sunset glow low in the frame; warm white type; amber labels, coral for the one accent per scene, violet for secondary marks. Pairs with the arizona-sunset reel.

signature.name: Arizona sunset (pixel dino reel)
signature.use: Dithered pixel sky behind a runner game; warm, scenic, reads well on phones. Type stays in the dark UI colours.

signature.name: Pictogram parable (black and white)
signature.use: Faceless explainer reels: white pictogram people on a dashed ground, black dot-grid background, white capsule tags, one soft glow behind the subject. Colour only on the end card.

signature.name: Dark ember title beats
signature.use: Black stage, white words, one hot orange-to-pink accent on the key word or card.

signature.name: Gold and black book film
signature.use: Long-form, premium: black, warm gold gradients on serif titles (Playfair, Rye), red accent for dates.

signature.name: Light studio with drifting orbs
